meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 里的助手能通过 Resend 收发邮件，和你进行邮件对话。它会自己完成代码添加和自检，然后请你粘贴 Resend 的密钥，把你的邮箱登记为所有者并发来问候邮件——回复那封邮件即可继续聊。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件渠道、或让它能收发邮件时，技能会开始执行。若是在 /setup 流程中间运行，最后会提示你回到原流程。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接上 Resend，让我能用邮件和它对话。
say.note: 会复制适配器并注册，然后引导配置密钥和邮箱。

say.text: 把我的邮箱 my@example.com 设为 Resend 所有者。
say.note: 会走完接入配置，再请你选择代理组并接线。

say.text: 接好 Resend 后，给我的邮箱发一封欢迎邮件。
say.note: 技能完成后会把问候邮件发到你的地址。

howto.what_en: Adds a Resend email channel to NanoClaw: copies/registers the adapter, runs build checks, prompts for Resend secrets, wires your email as owner, and sends a hello email.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to add a Resend email channel to NanoClaw or make it send/receive email. If run mid-/setup, it tells you to return to that flow afterwards.

say_en.text: Add Resend to NanoClaw so I can talk to it by email.
say_en.note: Copies/registers the adapter, then asks for secrets.
Runs setup, then asks for the agent group and wires it.

say_en.text: Once Resend is connected, send a welcome email to my address.
say_en.note: Sends the hello mail to your inbox at the end.
